name: Secondary dominant
summary: Temporarily tonicize a diatonic chord by preceding it with its dominant seventh.
useWhen: A target chord needs stronger arrival or a short lift into a section.
caution: Check melody notes against the altered leading tone; use sparingly in a simple pop arrangement.

name: Modal interchange
summary: Borrow a chord from a parallel mode while retaining the same tonic.
useWhen: A familiar progression needs a brief darker or wistful color.
caution: Keep the borrowed chord's voice leading smooth and avoid overuse.

source.title: SoundQuest — パラレル・マイナー ❶
source.author: yuta

name: Tritone substitution
summary: Replace a dominant seventh chord with another dominant seventh whose root is a tritone away.
useWhen: A chromatic bass approach or smoother inner voice is desired.
caution: May sound too chromatic for a simple pop hook; compare against melody.

source.title: SoundQuest — 裏コード / トライトーン代理 (index reference)
source.author: yuta

name: Passing diminished chord
summary: Insert a diminished seventh chord between two chords to connect voices chromatically.
useWhen: A brief passing motion connects neighboring chord tones.
caution: Keep duration short and ensure bass and upper voices lead into destination.

source.title: SoundQuest — パッシング・ディミニッシュ
source.author: yuta
